usedFor: SurveySparrow holds surveys and contacts, and Conversion Chats runs “Send Template Message” when a “New Contact” arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in SurveySparrow, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact can receive a message from a template you choose.

watchOut: “New Contact” in SurveySparrow is polling, so the template message follows a scheduled check.
